units.source_text: 数日后，我被分配给住持（我们称做老师）的房间送报。

en.t: A few days later, I was assigned to deliver the newspaper to the room of the abbot, whom we called the teacher.

units.source_text: 报纸派来的时间大致是在早课后扫除完毕的时候。

en.t: The newspaper usually arrived around the time when the cleaning after morning prayers was finished.

units.source_text: 在人手少、时间短的情况下，要打扫这拥有三十多间房屋的寺庙，

en.t: With few hands and little time, cleaning a temple that had more than thirty rooms,

units.source_text: 揩拭所有的走廊，工作就难免粗杂了。

en.t: and wiping down all its corridors, inevitably made the work rather rough and hurried.

units.source_text: 有一回从大门口把报纸取来，走过"使者间"的前廊，

en.t: Once, after fetching the newspaper from the main gate, I walked along the front corridor of the "Messenger's Room,"

units.source_text: 从客段后面绕了一圈，再穿过间廊，来到了老师所在的大书院。

en.t: made a circuit behind the guest hall, then passed through the connecting corridor and reached the large study where the teacher was.

units.source_text: 看得出这一路上的一道道走廊都是盗过半桶水，然后洗擦干净的，

en.t: It was clear that each corridor along the way had been splashed with half a bucket of water and then scrubbed clean,

units.source_text: 所以地板凹陷处都积了水。

en.t: so water had collected in every hollow of the floorboards.

units.source_text: 在朝阳照射下，积水闪闪发光，连脚踝骨都被濡湿了。

en.t: In the morning sun, the puddles glittered, and even my ankle bones became wet.

units.source_text: 时值夏天，觉得很是舒畅。

en.t: It was summer then, and the feeling was quite refreshing.

units.source_text: 可是，来到老师的房间拉门前就得跪下，

en.t: But when I came to the sliding door of the teacher's room, I had to kneel down,

units.source_text: 招呼一声"拜托您啦"，待所见"嗯"他一声回答以后，才能进入房间。

en.t: call out, "If you please," and only after he answered with a "Mm" could I enter the room.

units.source_text: 师兄教给我一个秘诀：在进老师房间前得先用僧衣下摆将濡湿了的脚丫指拭干净。

en.t: An elder fellow monk taught me a trick: before entering the teacher's room, I should first wipe my wet toes clean with the hem of my monk's robe.
